title: fix(plugin-security): explain's record-grained write verdict composes the by-id write gate's authored-row-write deferral
body:
Fixes #24647

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`security/explain`'s record-grained write verdict now composes the by-id write gate's authored-row-write deferral, the composition the sharing middleware already runs. When record sharing's per-record update or delete gate refuses a row, the door asks whether an app-authored row-level policy admits that row for the gate's verb (`ISecurityService.checkAuthoredRowWrite`, reached through `SharingService.probeAuthoredRowWrite`), and on `admit` hands the row to the pre-image gate. Explain asked the gate alone, so it answered `record.visible: false`, `decidedBy: 'sharing'` for a row whose `PATCH` is admitted. The divergence was restrictive: explain refused what the door admits, and nothing leaked.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts`: a new optional dependency, `probeAuthoredRowWrite`, asked only when the write gate answered `false`: for `update` and `delete` with the gate's verb, and for `transfer` as an `update`. Only the literal `admit` lifts the refusal. `abstain`, any other answer and a rejection keep it: the door's probe catches its own failure and keeps its refusal, so a failing probe is not reported as a failing request.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`: the explain binding wires it to the sharing service's own probe, when the service has one, with the context the gate is asked with (`withWriteScope`). A sharing service without the probe defers nothing, and explain reports the gate's refusal as before.
- `.changeset/24647-explain-authored-row-write.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-security` patch.

### What the record story reads for the new row

`record: { recordId, visible: true, decidedBy: 'rls' }`. `rls` is the layer that last admitted the row, which is the published meaning of `decidedBy`; no vocabulary value is added and `packages/spec` is untouched. The `sharing` layer's record keeps `outcome: 'excluded'` (record sharing itself still refuses), and its detail adds: "The by-id update does not stop at that refusal: an app-authored row-level update policy admits this record, so the write gate defers to row-level security (see the rls layer)." The `rls` layer's record reads `admitted`.

### Why the composition sits in the engine (a deviation from the suggested route)

Composing at the binding alone (`canEditRecord` answering `canEdit || admit`) makes the row `visible: true` but leaves the story's `sharing` layer at `admitted` with "The sharing service grants write on this record (ownership or an edit/full share)" and `decidedBy: 'sharing'`. That is a wrong "why" naming a share that does not exist, which is the cost the card names. So the deferral is a dependency the engine composes beside the gate, the way it already composes the master-detail check. This touches `explain-engine.ts`, which the claim's file surface did not list. No other open PR touches it.

## `delete` and `transfer`, included in place

- The door's delete path defers too: `buildSharingMiddleware` probes with the refusing gate's verb for both `update` and `delete`. A transfer's door is the by-id `PATCH` of `owner_id`, which the update gate judges and the same deferral lifts, and explain's transfer verdict rides the update gate. Measured before this change (the ablated run below): all three answered `visible: false`, `decidedBy: 'sharing'` beside an admitted door.
- The four in-place conditions hold: (1) the same defect class; (2) a mechanical fix, one composition with the verb its gate asked; (3) no other claim holds these files; (4) the same parity table, so no new validation surface. Each verb has its own parity row.
- `restore` and `purge` are not deferred: they have no by-id door, and the object gate refuses both to every principal.

## Security floor: no enforcement answer moves

- The door (`plugin-sharing`) and the `sys_attachment` / `sys_comment` parent gates are not edited.
- Both parent gates ask record sharing's `checkEdit` first and refuse on `deny` without asking explain. On the card's row the real `SharingService.checkEdit` answers `deny` under the gates' envelope, both with this change and with it ablated, so neither gate's answer can change. Each gate's own parity table already pins "`sharing deny` ⇒ refused, explain never called", with an explain double that would admit (`comment-parent-update-parity.test.ts`, `attachment-access-hooks.test.ts`).
- No path was found where explain's verdict decides a write alone today. The other `explain` callers ask object-level `create` or `read`, and objectui reads the verdict for UI affordance only.

**Pins a sibling card flips:** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-enforce-parity.test.ts`, test "an app-authored row-level write policy the by-id write gate defers to (ADR-0105 D3) › the parent gates' first question, record sharing, still refuses the row explain now admits". #24646 remains open. Its ruling (option B, comment 6279880675) has both gates ask only explain's record-grained update verdict, and that flips this pin: the gate then admits exactly what the parent's by-id update admits, which for this scenario, with this deferral, is admitted. The flip is pre-registered in a comment beside the assertion.

## Tests

All on head `2fdf7b1987`, each through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, verdict line `command-exit 0`:

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-security^...' build` (dependency closure), then the `./packages/**` build after the `main` merge.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 189 passed (189)`, `Tests 3794 passed | 45 skipped (3839)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0, and `check:test-typecheck: OK` (the test layer compiles under `tsconfig.test.json`, so the new rows are type-checked).
- `vitest run --reporter=verbose src/explain-enforce-parity.test.ts`: `Tests 106 passed (106)`. New cases: the table rows for update, delete and transfer of a row an authored policy admits (door admitted, explain `visible: true`), the two controls (a row no authored policy admits: door 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, explain `visible: false`), and three cases: the story (`decidedBy: 'rls'`, `sharing` layer `excluded`, `rls` layer `admitted`), the parent gates' first question (`checkEdit` is `deny` on the row explain now admits) and its positive control (the writer's own row: `checkEdit` `allow`, explain and the door admit).

## Ablation (a one-time proof; no permanent test file)

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `security-plugin.ts`, removing the binding's wiring of the probe (anchor count 1 to 0), on head `2fdf7b1987`:

- Mutated: `Tests 5 failed | 101 passed (106)`, failing in the expected direction (red). The update, delete and transfer rows show explain at `record: {"recordId":"l_theirs","visible":false,"decidedBy":"sharing"}` beside `enforcement {"kind":"admitted"}`, which is the card's divergence reproduced. The story case and the parent-gate case fail at the explain assertion. The parent-gate case's `checkEdit` assertion (`deny`) passes before that point, so the gates' first answer is the same with and without the change. The positive control and both refusal controls stay green.
- Restored: `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH`, blob equal to HEAD (`56d547d5ed1f`), `git diff HEAD` empty. The same ablation on the pre-merge head `d2e245471` gave the same 5 failures.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, run on head `2fdf7b1987` (the merge head) against the real diff: 69 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe. All 69 exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The derived list is identical to the one derived before the merge. Before the merge, three families first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (its pinned fixture commit was not reachable yet), `check:i18n` (CLI not built) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (not every package built). All three were re-run once their prerequisite was met, and all exit 0 in the final union. CI's own check-runs on this PR are the authority for every family CI runs.

## Acceptance notes

- `main` was merged once before this PR opened (merge commit `2fdf7b1987`): the claim's serial constraint said whichever of this card and #24623 lands second merges `main`, and #24623 landed (`d11fa8cc19`) with a change to `security-plugin.ts` at a disjoint region. The merge was clean. The build, the suite, the typecheck and the gate union were re-run on the merge head.
- The deferral's code tags read `[#5493 / ADR-0105 D3]`, following this file's existing tag for `checkAuthoredRowWrite`. ADR-0105 D3's own text is about stripping only the platform's wildcard tenant policies; the deferral's provenance is the #5493 ruling. A citation observation, not filed.
- Explain's `purge` record verdict asks the update gate (`engineOp === 'delete' ? canDeleteRecord : canEditRecord`), though a purge destroys like a delete. The object gate refuses `purge` to every principal, so the record verdict never reaches that gate. Dormant, not filed.
- `checkAuthoredRowWrite`'s docblock says a private-OWD cross-owner by-id write is still refused end to end. That holds for a caller whose read scope hides the row (the dogfood pin's principal). With `org` read depth the write is admitted, which the new parity row measures. Not filed.
